'''2011 World Championship''' was a Players Committee constructed World Championship, 11–14 August 2011, in Washington, D.C., using the pre-reset virtual pool ([[Legacy Open]]).<ref name="forum">https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewforum.php?f=565</ref><ref name="decklists">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2011-decklists/</ref><ref name="awards">https://www.starwarsccg.org/community/awards/</ref> Published lists on the Players Committee 2011 decklists desk are the Day 2 and Day 3 PDFs only (no Day 1 or Team Tournament PDF was published). [[Kevin Shannon]] defeated [[Brian Herold]] in the final.

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Site:''' Washington, D.C.
* '''Dates:''' 11–14 August 2011
* '''Winner:''' [[Kevin Shannon]]

Day 2 Xerox sheets are in [[:File:2011 Worlds Day 2.pdf]] (121 pages; blankish 23, 24, 49, 50, 70, 71, 97, 105). Objective titles above are from visual header inventory; deck pages link as each list is transcribed. Unnamed sheets (no player name and no 60 published): p39 name, deck name, date, and both side boxes blank; line 1 Kessel (V box empty), line 2 a Kessel site line reading Spice Mines Admin Office, line 3 Combat Readiness with the V box checked. p120 deck name 2/2, LIGHT checked, date 9/13/11, name blank; line 1 Coruscant: Night Club (not V); line 3 It Is The Future You See with the V box checked (not entered as the start). p121 name, deck name, date, and both side boxes blank; line 1 Watch Your Step (V box empty). Josh Mack's Day 2 Dark Side sheet (p78) is marked Same As Day 1 (no 60-card list on the form; Day 1 was not invented). Light Side is [[2011 Worlds Day 2 Josh Mack LS Communing|Communing]] (Speeder Bowl XL).
